answer: Incident: twelve answers, three identical, one owner. Cause: panel drawn from a single subnet. Fix: require jury diversity across unrelated regions for every quorum. Revoke every seat booked by an upheld challenge, then replay each hash against the ledger, since duplicates are caught by replay and not by name. Result: an opal label on an old jetty buys nothing, and the lagoon of stale clones drains.
